Pixel OS v2.0.0 — iOS 26 Liquid Glass Full OS on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Full iOS 26 SystemUI Surfaces (90Hz AGSL): Spatial Lock Screen (variable RobotoFlex typography, 3D glass rim, Live Flashlight & Camera quick-action orbs, UDFPS clearance), Swipe-Down Modular Control Center (2x2 Connectivity, Now Playing card, vertical Brightness & Volume pill sliders, 90Hz/Rotation/DND/Torch/Calculator/Camera/Styler tiles), Live Dynamic Island around 1080p center cutout (Calls, Media waveform, Clock Timers, SuperVOOC charging), and concentric Liquid Glass Notification Shade
• 3D Overlapping Stacked Card App Switcher in QuickStep Recents + Live Zero-Reboot Switch in iOS Styler v2.0 ('Full iOS 26 OS Mode' <-> 'Classic Pixel Mode' + per-surface toggles)
• 5 New Clean-Room 90Hz AGSL System Apps: Settings (IosSettings), Clock (IosClock), Calculator (IosCalculator), Notes (IosNotes), and Weather (IosWeather) alongside iCall 26 & Messages
